headline: Iran Closes Strait of Hormuz Following Israeli Strikes in Lebanon
summary: Iran halted the passage of oil tankers through the Strait of Hormuz hours after the first vessels began navigating the waterway. The move followed Israeli strikes in Lebanon.
why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of the world's seaborne oil, so disruptions there quickly affect crude prices and shipping costs. Energy markets react sharply to any threat to this chokepoint.
why_moved: Iran halted oil tanker passage through the Strait of Hormuz, a key route for seaborne crude. Halting flows through this chokepoint tightens supply and typically lifts oil prices.
